title: multi check names each lost claim and each landing stop of a run
goal: multi check --dir DIR reads a finished run's results, the sandbox coord store, the sandbox clones' backlog claims and the bare's main; it exits 1 naming each lost claim (a coord or backlog claim still held after every agent ended, or released with neither a commit nor a release event of its holder) and each landing stop (a code item not on the bare's main, with the land step that stopped); it exits 0 on a clean replay; multi run --replay --plant lost-claim and --plant land-stop each plant one such fault

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(B)
MARK = os.path.join(T, "claude-was-started")
open(os.path.join(B, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho started >> " + MARK + "\nexit 1\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, "claude"), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
def bench(*a, ok=(0,), timeout=1200):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=timeout)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-600:], r.stderr[-600:])
    return r

for plant, word in ((None, None), ("lost-claim", "lost claim"), ("land-stop", "landing stop")):
    d = os.path.join(T, plant or "clean")
    bench("multi", "run", "mixed", "--replay", "--dir", d, *(["--plant", plant] if plant else []))
    r = bench("multi", "check", "--dir", d, ok=(0, 1))
    if plant:
        assert r.returncode == 1 and word in r.stdout, (plant, r.stdout[-600:])
    else:
        assert r.returncode == 0, r.stdout[-600:]

clauses.clause: multi check --dir DIR reads a finished run's results, the sandbox coord store, the sandbox clones' backlog claims and the bare's main

it exits 1 naming each lost claim (a coord or backlog claim still held after every agent ended, or released with neither a commit nor a release event of its holder) and each landing stop (a code item not on the bare's main, with the land step that stopped)
it exits 0 on a clean replay
multi run --replay --plant lost-claim and --plant land-stop each plant one such fault
